items.headline: Commission reviews R3/R4 zoning rewrite recommendation
items.summary: The Environmental Planning Commission's October 7 agenda included a recommendation for adoption of amendments to the R3 and R4 multi-family zoning districts, along with related Precise Plan and General Plan amendments.

items.headline: 372-Unit Apartment Building Permitted at Trimble Yoshino Way Site
items.summary: A new apartment building with a reported 372 dwelling units at 120 Yoshino Way received a building permit with a declared permit valuation of $66,319,496. A companion permit issued the same day covers a parking garage for the project, valued at $27,952,287.
